      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_member, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_not_qc_other, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_supported, {const: true}]}
    note: "The sheltered-workshop exception to the gross income test is not encoded; the gross income input is used as given."

  - id: dependent.h_citizen_test
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Was the person a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. resident alien, or a resident of Canada or Mexico?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_can_claim_any
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing a joint return, or you can't be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 return"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "Open: the only supplied fact is sa.dependent, which also covers a dual-status alien; it is read as the Step 2/Step 4 question whether you could be claimed as a dependent."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent (Steps 1, 2 and 4)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_test, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_can_claim_any, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support]

  - id: dependent.h_tin_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Did the person have an SSN, ITIN, or ATIN issued (or applied for) on or before the due date of your return?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_citizen_us
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Was the person a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, or U.S. resident alien?"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_work_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "The child has an SSN valid for employment issued before the due date of your return"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 3: you can claim the child tax credit for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_tin_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_us, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_work_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.ctc_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Steps 3 and 5: you can claim the credit for other dependents for this person"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_tin_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_us, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
    note: "household.all_tin is read as Step 5, question 1 (you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN or ITIN issued or applied for by the due date)."

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,200 per qualifying child (Schedule 8812, line 5)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 5"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_ctc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$500 per other dependent (Schedule 8812, line 7)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 7"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_odc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$1,700 per qualifying child (Schedule 8812, line 16b)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This person's share of Schedule 8812, line 16b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_actc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household Test 1: your parent whom you can claim as a dependent, whose main home for all of 2025 you paid over half the cost of keeping up"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2_lived
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived in the home for more than half of the year (counting the exceptions to time lived with you)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_months_half, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.born_died, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.placed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.part_year_home, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Head of household Test 2: a qualifying person who lived with you for more than half of the year"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2_lived, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_relative, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married, dependent.multiple_support]
    note: "Excludes a dependent only because the person lived with you all year (household-member route). The divorced-parent and multiple-support cases are refused."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Time lived with you counts an absence from which return was not reasonably expected or during which the home was not kept up"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC Step 3: the person meets the conditions to be your qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc_age, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.divorced_rule, dependent.married]
    note: "No support test for the EIC. A married child and the divorced-parent rule are refused. The kidnapped-child rule (Pub. 596) and the tiebreaker are not encoded."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC qualifying child who has a valid SSN for the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen_ssn, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_dc_under13
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 13 when the care was provided"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Form 2441 qualifying person: a qualifying child under age 13 whom you can claim as a dependent, or a dependent not able to care for themselves who lived with you for more than half the year"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_dc_under13, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2_lived, {const: true}]}
    note: "A disabled person who would be your dependent except for gross income, a joint return, or your being claimable is not computed per person (Form 2441 handles it at return level); the custodial-parent rule is refused through dependent.claimed."

  - id: dependent.h_one_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sc.one_cent}

  - id: dependent.h_dc_flag
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent if a qualifying person, else zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_one_cent}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons this entry contributes (1 or 0)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: percent_floor, part: dependent.h_dc_flag, whole: {param: sc.hundred_cents}, cap: 1}
    note: "Read as this person's count toward the qualifying persons for the Form 2441 dollar limit: 1 when a qualifying person, else 0. Built as 100 x (1 cent or 0) / 100 cents because choose cannot return a Count."

  - id: dependent.h_ptc_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A dependent who is required to file an income tax return because of income"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.ptc_magi_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This dependent's modified AGI included on Form 8962, line 2b (Worksheet 1-2)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counted, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.ptc_magi}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counted, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.dc_paid}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.h_edu_base
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "A claimed dependent student with qualified education expenses, a Form 1098-T, and a TIN issued by the due date"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lines 23-26 lead to lines 27 through 30 (American opportunity credit), with the institution's EIN"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_base, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Go to line 31 for this student (lifetime learning credit)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_base, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_adj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 3: total adjustments (lines 2a, 2b and 2c)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_a_this_year, dependent.edu_a_next_year, dependent.edu_refunds]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_over_refused
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjustments exceed an academic period's expenses (per-period worksheet needed)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, gt: [dependent.h_edu_adj, {const: 0}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}
    note: "The worksheet is completed per academic period; the tool aggregates periods, which is valid only when no period's adjustments exceed its expenses."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc_exp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 1 (American opportunity credit): tuition, required fees and course materials"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_inst, dependent.edu_mat]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aqee_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4 (American opportunity credit). If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.h_edu_aoc_exp, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aqee_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4 (lifetime learning credit). If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_cap
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.expense_cap}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_27_figured
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses, not more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_edu_aqee_aoc, dependent.h_aoc_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_27_figured}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: {param: aoc.full_band}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_line29, dependent.h_aoc_band]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_28_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Line 28 is zero"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_28_zero, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.edu_line27}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_28_zero, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_29_plus}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions) (lifetime learning credit)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_aqee_llc}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_llc
```
